page_title: MAI 4-0 DAR | Mainz v Darmstadt 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+5' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Marcel Schuhen pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the roof of the net.
90+4' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Darmstadt is cautioned for aggressive play. Free kick. Mainz will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+2' A player from Mainz commits a rough challenge. Daniel Schlager blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar.
88' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
85' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Leandro Barreiro will be replaced by Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phillipp Mwene departs the field of play to be replaced by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
84' 4 - 0 Goal! Silvan Widmer plays a short, square pass into the path of Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 4:0. Fabulous goal!
82' Tom Krauss (Mainz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.

80' 3 - 0 Sensational! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the top of the left post and in the net. The assist goes to Silvan Widmer and the score changes to 3:0.
77' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Krauss (Mainz) is coming onto the pitch as Brajan Gruda cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emir Karic (Darmstadt) replacing Fabian Holland.
75' Substitution. Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) has come on for Julian Justvan.
75' Here is a change. Matthias Bader is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt).
75' It will be a substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is ready to enter the pitch as Anthony Caci walks off.
74' This is a yellow card! Brajan Gruda (Mainz) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' The Darmstadt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.
66' Mainz earn a corner.
66' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Phillipp Mwene (Mainz), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post. Mainz earn a corner.
63' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Brajan Gruda (Mainz) takes a short pass from Jonathan Burkardt in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the top left corner. 2:0.
59' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
58' The game is interrupted now, Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) commits a foul during an attacking move.
56' Although Alexander Brunst (Darmstadt) is just on the bench, Daniel Schlager has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
55' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mainz was in an offside position.
54' Substitution. Dominik Kohr is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz).
51' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) gets booked for the first time in this match.
51' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
50' Direct free kick. Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
49' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniel Schlager no option but to blow his whistle.
48' A player from Mainz commits a rough challenge. Daniel Schlager blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
46' Torsten Lieberknecht makes a switch. Aaron Seydel is coming on in place of Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) will not participate anymore and Gerrit Holtmann is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
44' An attempted cross from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Mainz win a corner kick.
42' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Daniel Schlager couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Anthony Caci (Mainz) and blew his whistle.
36' Mainz concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
35' Referee Daniel Schlager has finally had enough of Torsten Lieberknecht and brandishes a yellow card at him!

32' 1 - 0 GOAL! Jae-Sung Lee jumps high to meet the resulting free kick and nods the ball into the path of Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz), who is unmarked inside the box and slots the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
32' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes a direct free kick.
32' Daniel Schlager blows for a foul after Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
32' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
31' A lofted cross from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close! The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
28' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Mainz have a free kick.
26' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Schlager has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' 3:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.

23' Wasted effort! Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) received a nice pass in space from Braydon Marvin Manu, but his long-range shot was weak and floated well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
22' Darmstadt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
19' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
19' Braydon Marvin Manu (Darmstadt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Darmstadt will have a chance to score from a corner.
16' A snap shot by Brajan Gruda (Mainz) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Marcel Schuhen produces a good save to thwart him.
15' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Darmstadt is cautioned for aggressive play.
14' Daniel Schlager interrupts the game. One of the players from Mainz won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' The ball is cleared after Brajan Gruda (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' A player from Darmstadt commits a rough challenge. Daniel Schlager blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

10' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
8' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
6' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

5' Marcel Schuhen was forced into action to thwart Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

3' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mainz.
2' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

The players are out at last! Darmstadt will take the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager will officiate today.
